item.title: Iran War Live Updates: Tensions Rise as Iran Threatens to Retaliate Against U.S. Strikes
item.description: The threat came hours after American military forces renewed attacks in southern Iran, even as fragile diplomacy efforts to end the war continued.

item.title: Palestine's Eid dampened by consequences of war on livestock
item.description: Palestinians in Gaza facing another grim Eid holiday, which starts Tuesday evening. The livestock sector there has been destroyed by the war, and Israel isn't allowing the import of live animals, making the traditional animal sacrifice nearly impossible. Restrictions on border crossings also mean Palestinians are unable to perform the pilgrimage to Mecca.

item.title: Middle East live: US will no longer have safe haven in region, warns Iran's Khamenei after strikes
item.description: Iran's supreme leader Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei said on Tuesday that regional countries would "no longer serve as shields for American bases", in a written statement carried by state television. The remarks came after US forces struck missile sites and vessels allegedly laying naval mines in southern Iran, even as Tehran ​and Washington ​continue exchanges aimed at ending the war. Follow our liveblog for all the latest updates.

item.title: Possible Iran-US deal: What we know about the key issues on both sides
item.description: The United States and Iran have downplayed prospects for a rapid deal to end the Middle East war, despite signs of progress in talks. Key sticking points remain over Iran’s nuclear programme, control of the Strait of Hormuz, sanctions relief and a possible ceasefire in Lebanon, with both sides signalling that major issues are still unresolved.

item.title: Israel pounds Lebanon with fresh air strikes, vows to 'crush' Hezbollah
item.description: Israel intensified air strikes across southern and eastern Lebanon on Monday after Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu vowed to “crush” Hezbollah, deepening fears of a wider regional conflict. The escalation comes despite an April ceasefire and as another round of US-Iran talks takes place in Doha in a bid to negotiate terms for a broader Middle East peace deal.

item.title: U.S. strikes Iran. And, immigration courts use new tactic to speed up deportations
item.description: The U.S. military has launched new attacks on Iran while talks to end the conflict are ongoing. And, the Department of Justice is using a new tactic in immigration courts to accelerate deportations.

item.title: Evolving Warfare Connects the Conflicts in Ukraine and Iran
item.description: Aspects such as drone technology and diplomacy show how the wars intersect on the battlefield and in global alignments, providing a model for future conflicts.

item.title: ישראל מוציאה פקודות פינוי חדשות בדרום לבנון למרות ההפסקת אש
item.description: ישראל הורתה לתושבים בנבאטייה שבדרום לבנון לעזוב את המקום, תוך אזהרה מפני תקיפות נוספות נגד חיזבאללה, למרות ההפסקת אש. זאת לאחר שבנימין נתניהו הבטיח להחמיר את התקיפות בלבנון, בעקבות הריגת חייל ישראלי נוסף על ידי רחפן סיב אופטי ששלח חיזבאללה.

item.title: U.S. strikes targets in Iran, citing threats posed to American troops
item.description: The attacks in southern Iran prompted Tehran to warn that it reserves the right to retaliate, complicating negotiations to end the war.

item.title: Inquiry into antisemitism in Australia condemns online hatred and bigotry targeting witnesses
item.description: The head of an inquiry into antisemitism in Australia has condemned online hatred and bigotry targeting Jewish witnesses
